mapper.sql: id, code, name, sort, enabled, remark, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_post ORDER BY id
SELECT FROM sys_post WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_post (code, name, sort, enabled, remark, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{post.code}, #{post.name}, #{post.sort}, #{post.enabled}, #{post.remark}, #{post.createdAt}, #{post.updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_post SET code = #{post.code}, name = #{post.name}, sort = #{post.sort}, enabled = #{post.enabled}, remark = #{post.remark}, created_at = #{post.createdAt}, updated_at = #{post.updatedAt} WHERE id = #{post.id}
